Aviation Ministry Signs 21 Agreements to Boost Regional Connectivity

The Ministry of Civil Aviation has signed 21 agreements under the UDAN scheme to enhance regional air connectivity. The agreements involve the Centre, states, and Union Territories, aiming to expand regional aviation.
